南贤居出现了神秘的刺客，黑暗中的阴影逐渐逼近了。.en: A masked scout attacked at Grimm's home. Someone is watching our travels. Keep the party prepared and follow the clues.
南贤居出现了神秘的刺客，黑暗中的阴影逐渐逼近了。.zh-CN: 一名蒙面探子在格林家发动袭击。有人正留意我们的旅程。让伙伴们做好准备，继续追查线索。

text.en: Grimm? I got your note. You could at least have included a snack.
text.zh-CN: 格林？你的信我收到了。好歹也该捎点零食吧。

text.en: Who are you, and what are you doing in his house?
text.zh-CN: 你是谁，在他家里做什么？

text.en: Let's see how much you've learned.
text.zh-CN: 让我看看，你到底学会了多少。

text.en: If that was your introduction, I'd hate to hear your life story.
text.zh-CN: 自我介绍都这么费劲，你的生平故事我就不听了。

text.en: (The masked figure slips into the dark without another word.)
text.zh-CN: （蒙面人一言不发，退入了黑暗。）

text.en: All right. That's one way to end a conversation.
text.zh-CN: 行吧。这也算是一种结束谈话的办法。

text.en: (The masked figure slips into the dark without another word.)
text.zh-CN: （蒙面人一言不发，退入了黑暗。）

text.en: Any chance your next visitor could knock?
text.zh-CN: 下次来客，能不能先敲门？

text.en: That was a scout. Someone is taking a very close interest in your travels.
text.zh-CN: 那是个探子。有人对你的旅程，很感兴趣。

text.en: A scout? What does the welcoming committee look like?
text.zh-CN: 探子？那正式迎接我的阵仗得是什么样？

text.en: The stories haven't simply gone wrong on their own.
text.zh-CN: 这些故事，不是无缘无故出了问题。

text.en: So somebody's been meddling with them?
text.zh-CN: 也就是说，有人在里面捣乱？

text.en: That's what I suspect. A polite request to stop seems unlikely to work.
text.zh-CN: 我也这样怀疑。客客气气请他们停手，恐怕没什么用。

text.en: So much for solving this with a strongly worded letter.
text.zh-CN: 看来，写封措辞强硬的信也解决不了。

text.en: Keep your companions close. Even that scout knows Blackfire Lance.
text.zh-CN: 让伙伴们彼此照应。就连那个探子，也会黑焰法枪。

text.en: Then we'll keep learning. Preferably from people who don't ambush us.
text.zh-CN: 那我们就继续学。最好，找些不靠偷袭上课的人。

text.en: Explore, prepare, and help the people you meet. We'll follow the clues as they turn up.
text.zh-CN: 继续探索，做好准备，帮助路上遇见的人。有了线索，我们再接着查。
